title: Applicability of regulations in M1-1D through M1-5D Districts
previewText: In M1-1D, M1-2D, M1-3D, M1-4D and M1-5D Districts, the parking regulations governing M1 Districts shall apply to manufacturing, commercial or community facility uses, and the parking regulations applicable to R5 Districts, as set forth in Article II, Chapter 5, shall apply to residences.
